description: Batch update multiple cell ranges. RAW=exact values, USER_ENTERED=parsed like user input. Use a1-notation prompt for range syntax. For multiple clickable links or rich text inside a single cell, use values-markdown-update. NATIVE DATES: a native Sheets date/time is a serial number plus a date number format. The integer counts days from 1899-12-30; the fraction is the time of day (46334.5 = 2026-11-08 12:00, with a matching format). A serial carries no timezone of its own and is read in the spreadsheet's timezone. RAW stores values as supplied, so a date-looking string stays text; a numeric serial plus a date format is an explicit native-date write. USER_ENTERED may parse date strings the way the Sheets UI does, using the workbook locale. Keep the intended wall time/timezone and recorded precision: a date-only record is not an exact midnight event time, and existing timestamps are not reinterpreted. Example: (1) values-batch-update {"requests":[{"range":"B2","majorDimension":"ROWS","values":[[46334.5]]}],"valueInputOption":"RAW"}; (2) cells-format {"requests":[{"range":"B2","numberFormat":{"type":"DATE","pattern":"yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm"}}]}; (3) rows-get (or columns-get / values-search) {"range":"B2","render":"UNFORMATTED_VALUE"} returns 46334.5 (numeric, so it is not text), while render FORMATTED_VALUE returns "2026-11-08 12:00"; then check dependent chronological formulas. Docs: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/DateTimeRenderOption and https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/ValueInputOption

includeData.description: Whether to include updated cell values in the response

majorDimension.description: Whether values represent rows or columns

range.description: A1 notation range defining the bounded target area. Data dimensions must match range dimensions. Example: D1:D100 requires exactly 100 rows of data. Use open-ended ranges like D1:D to write any number of rows.

values.description: 2D array of values. Row count must match range height, column count must match range width. Use null to skip a cell (preserve existing value), empty string "" to clear it.

valueInputOption.description: How input data should be interpreted (required; no default is applied by the schema). RAW = exact values: date strings stay text, numeric serials stay numbers. USER_ENTERED = parsed like user input: date strings may become native dates per the workbook locale.

name: values-batch-update

totalUpdatedCells.description: Total number of cells updated across all requests

totalUpdatedColumns.description: Total number of columns updated across all requests

totalUpdatedRows.description: Total number of rows updated across all requests

updatedData.description: Detailed information about updated data (if includeData was true)

range.description: A1 notation range that was updated

updatedRanges.description: A1 notation ranges that were updated
